newsitem.title: USA: COMARCO expects to add $20 mln to revs.
newsitem.headline: COMARCO expects to add $20 mln to revs.

text.p: COMARCO Inc said on Monday that two recent acquisitions and several new contracts should help it increase revenues for its fourth quarter, ending January 31, and the following year.
"The combination of these events could increase COMARCO's revenues by over $20 million next year," it said.

In the fourth quarter ended January 31, 1996, Comarco generated $16.7 million in revnues, down from $18.4 million a year earlier. For the year, revenues rose to $69.8 million from $68.3 million in the previous year.
COMARCO recently announced it had won several contracts with a total value of about $70 million to provide engineering and management services to various government agencies.
COMARCO acquired R.A.L. Consulting and Staffing Services Inc, a $9 million a year provider of outsourced staffing to commercial enterprises in Southern California.
Last week COMARCO announced the closing of its acquisition of GTE's roadside cellular call box operation, which has annual revenues of about $5 million.
